content: Virtue is not left to stand alone. He who practices it will have neighbors.
author: Confucius
explanation: Living ethically can feel lonely in the short term, but genuine goodness possesses an irresistible gravitational pull. Those who cultivate integrity inevitably attract kindred souls.
practicalInsight: Do not despair if doing the right thing feels solitary today; trust that moral clarity acts as a beacon for noble companions.
reflectionPrompt: How has your commitment to integrity attracted trustworthy people into your life?
